annotations.title: Prove the domain of a claim

description: Check the proof placed for a claim: method "badge" (with pageUrl, the page the badge link is on), "meta" (the homepage meta tag) or "dns" (the TXT record). Answers verified, or what was missing. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

domain.description: The tool's domain as the Atlas lists it, e.g. acme.ai

pageUrl.description: For method "badge": the page on the site that carries the badge link
